title: Mini Racer Game for Reddit
author: shimroot
selftext:
Hello everyone 👋 

Some months ago I posted about a racing game I built using Cursor and Codex. 

Now that racing game has been remade as a daily Reddit game. Check it out here and leave some feedback: [https://www.reddit.com/r/MiniRacerGame/](https://www.reddit.com/r/MiniRacerGame/)

comments.author: loontoon
comments.body:
Tried it, but couldn't figure out how to control it.  I tried with my mouse but that didn't work so I gave up, sorry.   
Maybe put some instructions?

replies.author: shimroot
replies.body:
Thank you for the feedback.

left/right arrows or A/D didn't work?

replies.author: loontoon
replies.body:
Thanks!

I just retried it.  How do you slow down I can't even get to the first corner its way too fast!  LOL!

replies.author: shimroot
replies.body:
The car slows down automatically when you turn.  
The idea behind the game is to time your cornering and get the proper racing line for the best time. You cannot break on demand 😅

replies.author: loontoon
replies.body:
After a lot of tries I made it round the first corner.  I'm not a gamer so I don't have the finger coordination and reaction times that I had when I was much younger.   
I like the different car choices, do they perform differently?  Maybe have them increase in power as you progress so numpties like me can improve gradually hahaha!

replies.author: shimroot
replies.body:
Cars in the garage are just skins, they do not have any other effect.

Just launched this so I am gathering feedback at the moment, see what other players have to say. So your feedback is much appreciated!

replies.author: loontoon
replies.body:
Well done on getting into the Reddit games system.  Was it hard to get accepted?  

The first game I made was a simple phone word puzzle for a game jam.   
It needs some tidying up as the game jam finished and I didn't fix a few things. 

[https://cwpuzzle2.purpleprawn.com/](https://cwpuzzle2.purpleprawn.com/)

replies.author: shimroot
replies.body: Not that hard. Build the game, make a community to test it there, submit it for publishing. Didn't have any issues yet.

replies.author: loontoon
replies.body: That's great.  Wish you continued success!
